summary: BingEx Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides on-demand dedicated courier services under the FlashEx brand name in the People's Republic of China. The company offers Flash-Riders as service who provides the courier services. It serves individual and business customers, including local merchants, small and medium sized enterprises, restaurants, and logistics players through its mobile platform and website. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
